title: Manual staging accepts .doc and reads it as text
summary: The Stage 1 manual FileStagingArea accepts application/msword and reads every non-PDF file with readAsText, so a binary legacy .doc is not rejected on this path. The explicit 'save as .docx or .pdf' rejection exists only in the Streamline extraction service.
notes: Runtime output of readAsText on a binary .doc was not run; the static code has no conversion step on this path.

title: Stage 1 autosave is disabled; drafts are written only on Continue
summary: Stage 1 passes autoSave: false to the stage-state hook, with a comment that it is disabled to avoid a race with the manual lock. The draft is written only when the user presses Continue.
notes: Stage 2-4 do autosave on mount (STATE-0021); Stage 1 does not. Intake state before Continue is React state only (WD-IMPL-STATE-0032).

title: Stage 2 'Retroactively Revise Treatment' is a toast-only stub
summary: The retroactive-revision handler in Stage 2 only shows a toast reading 'Retroactive revision triggered' and does not call any service or route.
notes: The button is rendered and clickable; no regeneration from current beats occurs.

title: Beat treatment-excerpt view is never populated
summary: Beats declare an originalTreatmentExcerpt field and Stage 3 renders an expandable 'View original treatment context' block for it, but no code in src assigns that field, so the block never appears.
notes: Searched for assignments to originalTreatmentExcerpt in src/ and backend/src/; the only hits are the type declaration and the render site.

title: Aspect ratio has two values and can be changed at any stage
summary: The AspectRatio type and the PUT validator allow only 16:9 and 9:16, and the project update route accepts aspect_ratio with no check on stage lock state, so the setting is editable after Stage 2 has begun.
notes: The aspect ratio chip is shown in the project header (CAP-0052); whether any other code treats the value as locked was not traced.

title: Stage 1 option sets are fixed in the UI
summary: Stage 1 offers exactly 10 genres, 4 content ratings (G, PG, PG-13, M), 3 project types (narrative, commercial, 'Video for Audio'), and a 1-15 minute target-length slider. Any other value cannot be chosen in the UI.
notes: The audio-visual option is selectable but rejected by the backend (FACT-0046).

title: Stage 4 scene preview shows only number, heading, slug and opening action
summary: The Stage 4 preview dialog renders each previewed scene's number, header or slug, and opening action (or a 150-character excerpt). It does not show characters, location, or props, which the preview idea names.
notes: The preview is in-memory only (sceneService.previewScenes); no persistence occurs.

title: Streamline raw uploads are never stored; only routed text enters stage content
summary: Streamline documents are held in multer memory storage and only their extracted text is returned to the browser. The commit payload carries stage transitions, project config, Stage 1 draft, asset drafts, and resolutions, not the source files. Only staged reference images are uploaded to storage.
notes: Stage content holds the routed text (as-is or AI-formatted), so the words survive but the original file does not. Source-file traceability (INPUT-066) is therefore absent.

title: Unclassified and non-routed intake files drop out at routing and commit
summary: computeStreamlineRouting creates lines and stage transitions only for scripts, treatments, beat sheets, character/location notes and images. Files of any other or unclassified type produce no routing line and are not in the commit payload.
notes: Contradicts the 'unclassified files are kept as context, never discarded' idea. Routing tests exist (streamlineRouting.test.ts) but no test was found asserting that unclassified files are retained.

title: Writing style capsule text is injected only into the treatment, beat and master-script templates
summary: The {writing_style_context} placeholder appears only in the treatment_expansion, beat_extraction and master_script_generation seed templates. No Stage 7 or Stage 9 prompt builder in backend/src references writing capsules.
notes: Covers Stages 2-4 only; the idea's Stages 7 and 9 are not covered. Shot and prompt services were searched for writingStyle/writing_style (no hits).

title: Stage-specific context assembler has no production callers
summary: ContextManager.prepareStageContext, assembleFullContext and formatPromptGenerationContext have no callers outside tests. formatForInjection is called in production only by the Streamline backfill service.
notes: The only test referencing prepareStageContext is backend/src/tests/contextManagerAuteurResolutions.test.ts. Generation routes build prompt context inline in llm.ts.

title: Ask Auteur has four question categories and two-to-four options
summary: The Ask Auteur question schema allows four categories (contradiction, vague_trait, ambiguous_structure, missing_info) and instructs the model to produce 2-4 options per question. There is no separate conflict-resolution category.
notes: A streamlineQuestion.test.ts exists; it was not read for category coverage.

title: New beats default to 20 seconds and fallback beats to 60 seconds
summary: Adding a beat in the UI assigns estimatedScreenTimeSeconds 20. When the beat-sheet response cannot be parsed, the fallback beat uses 60 seconds. No control exists to change a beat's duration.
notes: Duration is displayed (Stage3BeatSheet.tsx:178) but is not editable in the beat sheet.

title: Beat-sheet narrative_structure is parsed and stored but never rendered
summary: The beat parser reads narrative_structure from the model output (default '3-act structure') and it is carried in Stage 3 content. No component renders it.
notes: Searched Stage3BeatSheet.tsx and related components for 'structure' display; only the type and assignment lines match.
